name: Metronome
description: A precise metronome with tap tempo, time signatures, subdivisions, accents you can set per beat and a swinging pendulum.
prompt: A metronome from 30 to 260 bpm with sample-accurate timing, tempo names, tap tempo, time signatures from 2/4 to 7/8, subdivisions, accent, normal or muted beats, three click sounds, a pendulum and vibration on accents.
author: gonzaroman
